scenario: [LEXP.3.7.4]: the compiler refuses a `bits`, `sign_extend` or `swap_bytes` call whose compile-time constant arguments ([LEXP.8.8]) place it outside [LEXP.3.7.3]'s domain whatever its other arguments hold. `s.x.bits(70, s.w)`: a field starting at bit 70 lies outside the pattern for every width, so it is DS_VALIDATE_BIT_FIELD_RANGE though `w` is known only at run time. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lexp_3_7_4_bit_field_range`, which reads each constant argument through `dsc.dstest.ltsl_4_1_constant`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    id: String key
    x: Int mutable
    w: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.x.bits(70, s.w) > 0
->
    log info "x"
